contract.repeated_unregister: A registered callback can be removed successfully on every cycle
contract.repeated_reregistration: The owner can re-register the callback successfully after each unregister
contract.duplicate_idempotency: Repeated registration of the same logical callback does not create duplicate listener entries
contract.registry_stability: The listener registry remains exactly one entry throughout every completed cycle
contract.delivery_once: Each emitted event is delivered exactly once to the registered callback
contract.emit_continuity: EventBus.emit() remains successful throughout repeated registration cycles
contract.registry_preservation: Event delivery does not alter the listener registry
contract.permission_enforcement: Every registration, unregister, and emit operation requires the events permission
